notes: Seed http://www.co.kenedy.tx.us/ returned 403; https redirects to www.kenedycountytx.gov whose Elections page links kenedycountyelections.com (WordPress). Results are scanned PDFs (VersaLink C405 scanner, no text layer, so contents read only from titles). The server's Last-Modified values are all midnight GMT dates (day granularity), so they are not usable as upload times; PDF CreationDate (scan time) shows every summary and precinct report was created after election night. No Clarity link. The page also links the SOS ENR (goelect.txelections.civixapps.com). Whether anything was posted on election night itself is not shown; check 3 pending.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (precinct reports scanned and posted after election night), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; check 2 has no election-night upload time, so confidence is low.
